A React component calls the `useFeatureFlag(flagName)` hook from `@openmrs/esm-react-utils`. It returns `true` only if that flag exists and is enabled. For an unknown or switched-off flag it returns `false`.

**Implementation**
- The hook is in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useFeatureFlag.ts` (lines 18–23). It reads `flags` from the `featureFlagsStore` through `useStore` and returns `flags[flagName]?.enabled ?? false`.
- The store and its helpers are in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts`:
  - `featureFlagsStore` is a global store named `feature-flags`. It starts from flags saved in localStorage under `openmrs:feature-flag:*`.
  - `registerFeatureFlag` creates a flag, which then shows up as a toggle in the Implementer Tools.
  - `setFeatureFlag` flips a flag. It is marked internal, for the Implementer Tools.
  - `getFeatureFlag` and `subscribeToFeatureFlag` are the non-React ways to read a flag. Their comments say to use `useFeatureFlag` in React.
- The hook is exported from `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/index.ts` (line 28) and `public.ts` (line 22).
- Tests can use the mocks in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock.tsx` (line 83) and `mock-jest.tsx` (line 78). Both make `useFeatureFlag` return `true`.
- Storybook has its own mock in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/storybook/mocks/esm-react-utils.ts` (line 109).

**Documentation**
- The API page is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/useFeatureFlag.md`. It includes this example:
  ```tsx
  const isMyFeatureFlagOn = useFeatureFlag("my-feature-flag");
  return <>{isMyFeatureFlagOn && <ExperimentalFeature />}</>;
  ```
- The hook is listed in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/API.md` (line 210).
- The docs for `getFeatureFlag` are in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/getFeatureFlag.md`.

I only searched `openmrs-esm-core`. A search of the `openmrs-rfc-frontend-docs` repository failed because Sourcebot doesn't have it. I didn't check `openmrs-esm-patient-chart` or the other repositories for uses of the hook.
